operations.title: Benincasa proves five-site first-Rees occurrence exactness away from soft support
operations.body: Entry 1205: the first-Rees occurrence symbols form regular sequences in Q[X1,...,X5]/(E_T) for every term. Profiles are 10 with none, 80 one 1|4, 20 one 2|3, 50 two 1|4, and 20 mixed 1|4+2|3. Positive Koszul homology is zero; only declared codim-1/2 soft support remains. Next is the supported restriction/Gysin calculation, since generic exactness does not imply supported exactness.
